free.question: Is listing my property free?
free.answer: You can start the partner flow without a setup fee. Any future payment or commission rules should be shown before partners publish or accept bookings.

approval.question: Will my property be public immediately?
approval.answer: New property submissions may require admin approval before they appear publicly. This helps keep listing information accurate and trustworthy.

customerAccount.question: What if I already have a customer account?
customerAccount.answer: You can use the list-property entry from your account menu. The current flow opens the partner account path; a future upgrade flow can connect partner access to the same account.

manage.answer: Partners can manage property details, room information, availability, reservations, and guest communication as those modules become available.

hero.title: How SrokYerng Booking protects your information
hero.subtitle: This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have when using our booking platform.
hero.note: We keep this page clear so travelers and property owners can understand our privacy practices without legal confusion.

security.title: Secure By Design
security.desc: We use reasonable safeguards to protect account, booking, and communication data.

control.title: Your Data Choices
control.desc: You can contact us to review, correct, or request deletion of your personal information.

transparent.title: Clear Use
transparent.desc: We use data to support bookings, improve service quality, and keep the platform reliable.

information.title: Information We Collect
information.body: We collect information you provide directly and information generated when you use SrokYerng Booking.

points.account: Account details such as name, email address, phone number, and role.
points.booking: Booking details such as selected property, dates, guests, messages, and reservation status.
points.payment: Payment-related records needed to confirm and manage bookings.

usage.title: How We Use Information
usage.body: We use information to operate the platform, support customers, help property owners, and improve the booking experience.

points.service: Process reservations, account actions, property listings, and service requests.
points.support: Respond to questions, solve booking issues, and provide local customer support.
points.safety: Detect misuse, prevent fraud, and maintain a trustworthy booking environment.

sharing.title: When We Share Information
sharing.body: We only share information when it is needed to deliver the service, meet legal requirements, or protect users.

points.hosts: Share necessary booking details with property owners or managers.
points.providers: Work with service providers that support hosting, communication, analytics, or payments.
points.legal: Disclose information when required by law or to protect rights and safety.

protection.title: How We Protect Data
protection.body: We apply practical controls to reduce unauthorized access, misuse, loss, or disclosure of personal data.

points.access: Limit access to people and systems that need the data to provide the service.
points.review: Review platform activity and technical safeguards as the product evolves.
points.retention: Keep information only as long as needed for service, legal, and operational purposes.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: You can contact us about your personal information and we will respond according to applicable requirements.

points.access: Ask for a copy of information related to your account or bookings.
points.correct: Request corrections if your information is inaccurate or incomplete.
points.delete: Request deletion where the information is no longer needed or legally required.

contact.title: Need help with privacy?
contact.subtitle: If you have questions about this policy or your information, contact our support team and we will help you through the next step.

hero.title: The rules for using SrokYerng Booking
hero.subtitle: These terms explain how travelers, property owners, and SrokYerng Booking work together when using our platform.
hero.note: Please read these terms before making a booking, creating an account, or listing a property.

clear.title: Clear Expectations
clear.desc: We explain the responsibilities of guests, owners, and our platform in plain language.

trust.title: Trusted Use
trust.desc: Users must provide accurate information and use the platform respectfully.

payment.title: Booking Payments
payment.desc: Prices, fees, confirmations, and refunds follow the rules shown during booking.

acceptance.title: Accepting These Terms
acceptance.body: By using SrokYerng Booking, you agree to follow these terms and any policies shown during your use of the platform.

points.use: You must use the platform only for lawful booking, listing, or account purposes.
points.account: You are responsible for keeping your account information accurate and secure.
points.updates: We may update these terms when needed and will keep the latest version on this page.

bookings.title: Bookings And Stays
bookings.body: Bookings depend on availability, property rules, and accurate information from guests and property owners.

points.accuracy: Guests should review dates, room details, prices, and policies before confirming a booking.
points.confirmation: A booking is confirmed only when the platform or property owner confirms the reservation.
points.rules: Guests must follow house rules, check-in instructions, and safety requirements from the property.

payments.title: Payments, Fees, And Refunds
payments.body: Payment terms may vary by property, reservation type, and payment method shown during checkout.

points.pricing: Prices should be reviewed before payment because taxes, fees, or discounts may apply.
points.fees: Service fees or payment processing costs may be included where shown.
points.refunds: Cancellations and refunds follow the policy shown for the selected property or booking.

responsibilities.title: User Responsibilities
responsibilities.body: Travelers and property owners both help keep SrokYerng Booking reliable, respectful, and useful.

points.guests: Guests must provide accurate details and treat properties, owners, and staff respectfully.
points.owners: Property owners must keep listings, prices, availability, and property information accurate.
points.content: Users must not upload misleading, harmful, illegal, or unauthorized content.

limitations.title: Limitations And Disputes
limitations.body: We work to keep the platform reliable, but some services depend on property owners, payment providers, and external systems.

points.availability: We cannot guarantee that every property, price, or service will always be available.
points.thirdParty: Some payments, maps, messages, or integrations may be provided by third-party services.
points.disputes: If there is a dispute, contact us so we can help review the issue and guide the next steps.

contact.title: Questions about these terms?
contact.subtitle: If anything is unclear, contact our team before booking or listing a property.
